steps: eval import('/app.js').then(m => { m.drawer(($slot, $body) => { $slot.el.textContent = 'Forced'; $body.el.textContent = 'Opened by eval — the module API, not a click.'; }); return m.drawer.showing(); })

eval (() => { const a = document.querySelector('.drawer').getBoundingClientRect(), b = document.querySelector('.pages').getBoundingClientRect(); return { drawer: [Math.round(a.x), Math.round(a.width)], pages: [Math.round(b.x), Math.round(b.width)], covered_px: Math.round(b.right - a.left) }; })()
